description: This Java source file defines the class FirstMoment, which calculates the first moment (mean) of a dataset using an incremental algorithm. It extends AbstractStorelessUnivariateStatistic and implements Serializable, and includes methods for incrementing the dataset, clearing data, copying instances, and retrieving the result.

classes.name: FirstMoment
classes.description: Calculates the first moment (mean) of a dataset with incremental updates, extending AbstractStorelessUnivariateStatistic.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Adds a new value to the dataset, updating the mean using a recursive formula.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the statistic's internal state, preparing for new data.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Returns the current estimated mean of the dataset.

methods.name: getN
methods.description: Returns the number of data points added.

methods.description: Creates a copy of the current FirstMoment instance.
